name: Puerto Galera

travelerValues: Care for linked land and water habitats
origins: The cited community material records Iraya-Mangyan artisans and livelihoods connected to land and sea. It does not date the earliest habitation or identify one discoverer. Existing communities are not made newly discovered by an outsider’s arrival.
discovererStatus: The available source material does not establish a single discoverer. Administrative dates, name stories, and outsider arrival do not establish the beginning of habitation.
evidenceStatus: Inherited, attributed material; fresh verification and community review remain pending.

origins: Act 3498 reestablished Baco and San Teodoro separately effective 1 January 1929. Earlier research also names Iraya and Alangan communities in Baco. The law does not establish the first arrival of people or erase those communities’ histories.
discovererStatus: The available source material does not establish a single discoverer. Administrative dates, name stories, and outsider arrival do not establish the beginning of habitation.

origins: Victoria was formed from territory formerly belonging to Naujan in 1953, according to the municipal history. This records a jurisdictional change; it does not establish that the territory was previously uninhabited.
